work_equivalent_definition: One attempted physical primitive assembly at one endpoint with at most 78465 time nodes; one additional equivalent for each JVP direction. A coarse assembly is conservatively charged the same as a maximum-grid assembly. Dispatch counts, JVP lanes, actual time nodes, FFT/refinement traversals and CPU are separately journaled. Work equivalents are conservative budget tokens, not FLOP or wall-time equivalence.
refinement_accounting: Frozen maximum factor128 fields may be decimated to64/32 without new physical assembly. Every FFT, guard, quadrature method, node traversal and failure is logged. Reassembling at any factor costs another equivalent. Beyond factor128 or available support means refusal, not automatic expansion.
time_prior: raw log integral primary; optional normalized uniform time average subtracts log(613/4096), with unchanged gradient
mixed_direction_steps: d=(1,-1,1,-1,1,100)*1e-5 in physical coordinate units, with endpoints theta +/- d and theta +/- d/2; reference quadrature and support frozen over all stencil rows
stop: array failure prevents physical phase; unresolved convergence, reconstruction/cross-backend or derivative mismatch stops physical stage immediately; no inference or fallback replacement
original_failure_origin: faithfully reconstructed after matching15 saved prefix batches; not an original failed-batch capture
runtime_changes: research modules and isolated scratch only; no production library or shared environment changes
